body:
### Fixed
- APDU exchange with a card selected without AID (e.g. a SAM selected by its power-on data) failed with "Channel is not open": the basic channel is now opened on first transmission.
- The OMAPI session was not closed when closing the physical channel if no channel had been opened.
- R8 build failure of the applications using the plugin ("Missing class  org.simalliance.openmobileapi..."): the library now provides the required consumer rule.
### Changed
- Android applications written in Kotlin must now use Kotlin `2.2` or later to compile against this library.
### Removed
- Unused `viewBinding` build feature and `kotlin-parcelize` plugin: the `androidx.databinding:viewbinding` dependency is no longer propagated to the applications.
### Upgraded
- `keyple-util-java-lib` from `2.4.1` to `2.5.0`
- `kotlin-stdlib` and Kotlin Gradle plugin from `1.7.20` to `2.3.21`
- Android Gradle plugin from `7.4.2` to `9.4.1`
- Android `compileSdk` from `33` to `35`
- Gradle from `8.9` to `9.8.1`
- Dokka from `1.9.20` to `2.2.0`
- Spotless from `7.0.4` to `8.2.1`
